segments.text: THe queſtions to bee conſidered hereof, are fiue.

1 What mans deliuerie is, or in what things it conſiſteth.
2 Whether anie deliuerie might be wrought after the fall.
3 Whether it bee neceſſarie, and certaine.
4 What manner of deliuerie it is, and whether it bee perfect, that is a deliuerie from the euill both of crime and paine.
5 By what meanes it may be wrought.
